# hpe_morpheus_network_dhcp_server (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_dhcp_server" "example" {
  id                     = 99
  network_integration_id = 1
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_dhcp_server" "example" {
  name                   = "Example name"
  network_integration_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_integration_id` (Number) The ID of the network integration this DHCP server belongs to

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Morpheus ID of the network DHCP server
- `name` (String) The name of the network DHCP server

### Read-Only

- `config` (Dynamic) Generic DHCP Server Configuration
- `config_nsx` (Attributes) Configuration object with parameters that vary by type (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_nsx))
- `lease_time` (Number) Lease time in seconds for the DHCP server
- `server_ip_address` (String) Server address for the DHCP server

<a id="nestedatt--config_nsx"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config_nsx`

Read-Only:

- `active_edge_node` (String) Active Edge Node
- `edge_cluster` (String) Edge Cluster
- `standby_edge_node` (String) Standby Edge Node
